instruction: Which four HTTP request methods does RFC 9110 define as safe?

Match each HTTP status-code class from 1xx through 5xx to its category name.

Starting from HTTP Semantics, use Idempotent Methods to define idempotence, list the methods explicitly named as idempotent, and explain why the property permits automatic retries after communication failure.

gold_answer.definition: Multiple identical requests have the same intended server effect as one request.
gold_answer.retry_reason: Repeating the request has the same intended effect even if the first request succeeded before its response was received.

instruction: Starting from the RFC's 200 OK table, map GET, HEAD, POST, PUT/DELETE, OPTIONS, and TRACE to what the response content represents.

gold_answer.HEAD: the target resource, like GET, but without representation data
gold_answer.POST: the status of or results from the action
gold_answer.OPTIONS: communication options for the target resource
gold_answer.TRACE: the request message as received by the server returning the trace
